description: One pundit's election record: their graded record from past cycles (accuracy, MissedTakes Score, sample size) and their calls in the current cycle, newest first. Look up by slug, or by part of their name.

cycle.description: The cycle whose calls to list. Omit for the current one.

name.description: Part of the pundit's name, when the slug is unknown.
